responsibility: Implements rustc’s built-in `#[derive(...)]` expansion pipeline by registering and dispatching derive names, providing the shared generic AST-generation framework and type/path abstractions used to synthesize impls, and supplying the trait-specific expanders for marker and standard derives: marker-style bounds-based derives (`Copy`, `ConstParamTy_`, `UnsizedConstParamTy`), structural and ordering traits (`PartialEq`, `Eq`, `PartialOrd`, `Ord`, `Hash`), value-construction and formatting traits (`Clone`, `Default`, `Debug`), and the legacy serialization derives (`RustcEncodable`, `RustcDecodable`).
